children.role_hint: Main complementary OTA signal-path core. NMOS and PMOS input transistors form a complementary differential transconductance stage. The internal node net2 provides self-biasing/control of the NMOS tail device M2, while ib_sink biases PMOS current-source device M5. The single-ended amplified output is vo.
